svg.aria-label: Edda, fine-tuned for Danish developers (in progress)
svg.title: Edda, fine-tuned for Danish developers (in progress)
svg.text: Danish speech models trip over the English words developers say all day. I’m training LoRA adapters on
Edda v0.2 with my own voice, so WalkieTalkey writes deploye, merger and PR’en the way we say them,
without getting worse at plain Danish.

g.text: Skal vi slå de commits sammen, før vi merger?
Deploy ikke om fredagen, medmindre det er en akut rettelse.
Staging er nede, så vi kan ikke prøve noget i øjeblikket.
Featuren er slået fra indtil videre.

svg.text: Base model: Edda v0.2 by the Alexandra Institute and Danish Foundation Models, trained on CoRal.
